description: Use this when the user wants to manually create a time entry for past work, rather than using the timer.

billable.description: Whether this task should be billable to the client. Defaults to project setting.

description.description: Optional description of what work was done

endDateTime.description: Optional end time in ISO 8601 format. If provided, creates a completed task.

projectId.description: The project ID this task belongs to

startDateTime.description: When the work started in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-10-08T09:00:00Z")

name: task_create

action.description: What happened to the task (the rest of the object is the full task)

duration.description: Duration of the task in seconds (if endDateTime was provided)

id.description: The ID of the newly created task

title: Create Task
